input.rationale: Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) addresses only notice periods and the Termination Payment; there is no exit, transition-assistance, data-return, migration or deletion provision anywhere in the Agreement. This is a site development and hosting agreement in which HDI operates the Site on its own server (Sections 1.3, 1.4) and holds our Content, user information and customer data (Section 8.1), so on termination we would have no contractual right to recover that data or to obtain migration help. The confidentiality provisions (8.1-8.2) restrict use and disclosure but do not require return or deletion, and the survival clause (10.7) does not fill the gap. Playbook expects at minimum 90 days of transition assistance and data export within 30 days; nothing here meets even the fallback, so we insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position (up to six months' assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return within 30 days in machine-readable format, then certified deletion).

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide transition assistance and return/delete Company data on termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on exit: HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and customer data, but owes us nothing back on termination. We have added a standard transition-assistance and data-return provision (up to six months' assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, then certified deletion). We can accept 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue, but return of our data within 30 days is required.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates, including reasonable cooperation in migrating the Site to the Company or its designee; (b) within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Confidential Information of the Company then in HDI's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Content, user information, customer data and other Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to the Company.
